description: Resignation letter with notice-date math — Draft a positive, professional resignation letter (name; optional company, manager, role, reason, tone, date, lastDay or noticeWeeks default 2). Computes the last working day offline (moves weekends and US federal holidays to the previous business day), notice in calendar and business days, flags under two weeks' notice, negative wording and a missing last-day sentence, and adds a transition checklist (final pay, PTO, COBRA, equipment). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
